Company Overview

Reliance Industries (RIL) is India's largest company by market cap (~₹17.7 lakh crore), a diversified conglomerate spanning Oil-to-Chemicals (O2C), digital services (Jio, 52.4 cr subscribers, +7% YoY), organised Retail, and a fast-scaling New Energy vertical. FY26 consolidated sales were ~₹10.56 lakh crore at a 17% operating margin. The stock closed at ₹1,310 on 19-Jun-2026 — down ~18.7% from its 5-Jan-2026 record high of ₹1,611 and hovering just above its 52-week low of ₹1,253. It trades below all key moving averages, putting a strong fundamental case against a weak near-term chart. The AGM-2026 (mid-June) kept the stock in focus on value-unlock expectations.

Investment Thesis

Key drivers / catalysts

  • Jio value-unlock / potential listing — 52.4 cr subs, ARPU lever
  • Retail growth + possible value-unlock
  • O2C profitability recovery on better refining/chem spreads
  • New Energy (solar/giga-factories) optionality

Risks

  • Technical downtrend — below all key EMAs, RSI <50
  • O2C cyclicality, regulatory/telecom-tariff risk

Conclusion
